blocks.content: The primary mission of IRDAI is to protect the interest of policyholders and ensure orderly growth of the insurance sector in India.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: IRDAI is an autonomous statutory body established under the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999.
The primary mandate of IRDAI is to protect policyholder interests and foster fair growth in the insurance sector.
Formed following recommendations from the Malhotra Committee Report of 1994.
The authority headquarters were moved from New Delhi to Hyderabad in 2001.
IRDAI was set up based on the recommendations of the Malhotra Committee (1994).
Composition of IRDAI: 10 members (1 Chairman, 5 Full-Time Members, and 4 Part-Time Members) appointed by the Government of India.
IRDAI headquarters relocated from New Delhi to Hyderabad, Telangana in the year 2001.
